Fixed in 46fb344. All four web callers moved to the Result variants. manage-content.tsx no longer redirects on an unknown: the redirect runs only on ok && !isGymManager, so a transient gym_managers failure shows an error plate instead of throwing a real manager off their own page. gym-detail-content.tsx renders from partial when the session list is trustworthy so a live session is never hidden behind a capability failure. NOTE a deliberate judgement call at gym-header-manage-link.tsx: on an unknown it SHOWS the link (hiding strands the real owner; showing costs a non-manager one redirect, and every write behind it is RLS-gated). The one-line flip is documented in a comment there.

Fixed in 46fb344. Replaced the top-50 client-side grouping with the existing get_gym_ladder RPC, which aggregates over every active athlete and returns an exact athlete_count and avg_elo in one round trip. get_gym_member_counts was rejected because it would have fixed only the count and left the average a slice artefact. totalElo is derived as round(avg x count), within under 1 ELO for a 15-member gym. No prop consumed by leaderboard-content.tsx changed. Side effect: the gym board now lists every active gym with at least one member, not only gyms represented in the global top 50.

Fixed in 46fb344. An unconfirmed removeChannel now bails out of ensure() and retries with backoff (1s/2s/4s) instead of adopting the still-joined channel and calling .on() on it, which throws. The dishonest test mock was made honest: on() now throws when the channel is joined, matching RealtimeChannel, which turns the suite red against the old code with the exact production error at use-lobby-presence.ts:199.

Fixed in 46fb344. The untrack is still issued first but is no longer awaited ahead of the durable write, so the looking_for_ranked clear goes out in the same tick instead of queueing behind up to 10s of buffered presence push. Applied uniformly, not only on the background path. Tests now model the timing with a hand-released deferred, and one asserts the flag write lands while the untrack is still in flight. A foreground re-assert was added that only undoes the defensive clear, never a deliberate toggle-off.

Fixed in 46fb344. Added beginMatchUploadAttempt(matchId) which REPLACES the entry rather than merging; every field except matchId is now explicitly per-attempt, documented in the store docblock. Called at the moment start() commits past every guard, so a start that never reaches the camera leaves the previous outcome intact.
